about_the_game:
Welcome to DreamWorld, a (literally) groundbreaking Sandbox MMO, where everything is fully destructible, and all players create their wildest imaginings together, in one single infinite world. Adventure through unending and fantastical biomes, collect rare resources, basebuild and craft your way to glory, and slay world bosses with friends new and old. 80+ hours of core gameplay- with more in development, and a limitless creative canvas to fill.


Easy-build magnetic snapping, freehand placement, scale and rotate pieces on any axis, build out of any resource you collect (hundreds to discover and craft), copy & paste entire cities, and use in-game AI to create custom building pieces in live time. 

From Golden Mushrooms on mountains, to Warrium growing deep in infinite and treacherous caves and tunnels- every biome, subbiome, topography, time of day, and distance you traverse further from the center of the world holds unique and powerful treasures. 

Hop in game, build a DreamForge, and type whatever you’re imagining. State-of-the-art AI will take your description and turn it into a custom building piece for you to create with in live-time. Fully replicated, so everyone can see your creativity.

80+ hours of core progression through nightmarish enemies and indispensable basebuilding. Collect, craft, and wield powerful weapons, spells, terraforming, and even the power of friendship in your bid for victory.

Build in peace, engage the terrors when you want. Massive shared world bosses drop the rarest loot- IF you can slay them. Titanic Eldritch creatures churn through the earth beneath you like sharks, waiting for you to make a sound. Leviathans stalk the depths, and animals across the land search for their next meal. Show up prepared. And armored. 

 

No picking a server to make sure you’re playing with your friends- there’s just the one that everyone plays in together. No confusion, no fragmentation, just one world for all of your dreams, creations, adventures, and people.  

In DreamWorld, there is no “bedrock”, and no “build limit”- just infinite treasure-filled caves and beautiful open sky. Collect everything you see, build anything, mine away (or place down) an entire mountain, level (or grow) a forest, share the coordinates with your communities, and host thousands to your genius, any time, any place. If you want tools that aren’t there, message us in Discord, and we’ll put them in. 

In an infinite world, movement is king. Climb any surface, dive to any depth, soar into the heavens, and collect friendly beasts to ride across fantastical terrain. There are no facades, there’s no “out of bounds”- just you, complete freedom, and endless possibilities.  

Some Development & Key Feature Notes 

“During This First Dev Phase, DreamWorld Has Focused Most On Delivering Industry-First Technical Feats” 

  • Single, seamless, infinite world 

    • Pick a direction, go forever. No other servers to join, just one world for everyone. 

  • Highest density simultaneous multiplayer in gaming 

    • Thousands before sharding and other scalability improvements.    

  • Full destructibility, landscape deformation, and buildability 

    • Fully destructible voxel world, everything you see is a resource you can obtain.   

  • Best building system of any game, especially MMOs 

    • 50M+ building piece player-built cities, some builders have 5000+ hours in game.  

  • Full persistence, replication, and permanent impact 

    • One world for all - leave your mark in builds, terraforming, and stories.    

  • In-game live-time AI text to 3D asset creation 

    • Place a DreamForge building piece in game, use it to prompt your dreams to life.  

  • Highest density of highest detail User Generated Content (UGC) in gaming    

    • Each building piece has thousands of tris, players have built 50M+ piece cities.  

— It is because we have focused on these industry-leading technical feats that DreamWorld does not yet have AAA art (we actually only have one full time Artist! He’s amazing), or typical MMO features like Professions and Guilds, however these are next up on our development roadmap, and partnered with the technical feats we’ve brought to life, will offer truly novel MMO experiences for players around the world. 

— That being said, DreamWorld still TODAY has 80+ hours of core crafting and survival progression gameplay comparable to Enshrouded, Valheim, and Minecraft, with MMO architecture on top. Players that jump in now will have a fun, worthwhile single player experience even if they decide to never engage with DreamWorld’s multiplayer MMO systems. 

“DreamWorld Has The Best Building System In Gaming” 

DreamWorld’s building system includes these features : 

  • Freehand, no-snapping building piece placement (specialist placement, full control)  

  • Snapping building piece placement (easy, fast, like Fortnite and Minecraft) 

  • Scaling of building pieces on every axis (make your pieces as big or small as you want) 

  • Rotation of building pieces on every axis (place a chair upside-down and take a seat ;) )  

  • Build out of every resource in the world (yes, players have made Raw Meat castles)  

  • AI text-to-3D (have AI generate exactly the building piece you’re looking for in live time) 

  • Beautiful DW Team-Created Art (DW provides hundreds of beautiful building set pieces)  

  • Select & Move (select your building pieces and easily move them elsewhere) 

  • Select & Delete (mass-delete your builds to start over, get all of your resources back) 

  • Copy & Paste (select your builds, turn them into Blueprints, and paste them elsewhere) 

  • DreamWorld supports the highest volume of highest detail UGC in gaming today 

<Pictures of DreamLord City (player made) with 50M+ building pieces> 

<”For context”, it has been reported that Valheim and Pax Dei can only support ~50k building pieces in their entire game worlds before they get too laggy to play. Minecraft and Enshrouded cap UGC to build heights and even small “build zones”. DW can have tens of millions of pieces in just one small area, run at 60+fps in those areas on even 8 year old computers, and empowers players to build anywhere at any time, infinitely up, down, and out in any direction. Other games say they support limitless creativity- DreamWorld actually delivers.>     

  • Basebuilding progression (claim spaces, upgrade them, crafting, farming, and buffs)    

  • Permissions (specify who can and cannot do what in your claimed spaces)     

  • Fully deformable voxel world (dig/mine terrain anywhere with craftable tools & magic)      

  • Things you build give you buffs (build totems & mount Boss Trophies for cool powers)   

  • Build minigames with interactive pieces (launchers, portals, trampolines, and more)             

  • Build to win (use building & terraforming to gain advantages in Boss fights) 

A High Level List of Core Features : 

  • Tool and Gear Crafting (12 tiers) 

  • World Exploration (thousands of biome + topography + sub-biome variations) 

  • Subterranean Gameplay (infinite tunnels and caves) 

  • AI Creation Feature (in-game, live-time generation of custom building pieces)  

  • Building System (see above) 

  • Terraforming (the entire world is deformable)  

  • Quests (through all four main bosses) 

  • Tutorial (learn on rails, or ignore them and discover DreamWorld yourself)  

  • Land Ownership (claim a space and build your dreams)   

  • Social Features (friends, permissions, emotes, text chat, proximity voice chat)   

  • World Bosses (the Four Fears, don’t face them alone) 

  • Mounts (incredible beasts to ride across fantastical lands)  

  • Infinite Procedural World Generation (pick a direction and adventure forever)  

  • Full Destructibility System (everything you see can be a resource to collect)  

  • Farming (create your cozy farm, and raise powerful crops)  

  • Preliminary Magic System (craft and wield powerful magic- much more coming)  

  • Cooking (cook the buffing meals you’ll survive and thrive on)  

  • Potion Crafting (gain the ultimate edge in any situation)  

  • Over 200 Different Resources/Materials (collect and craft for hundreds of hours)  

  • Thousands of Concurrent Players Server (play with all of your friends, MMO)  

  • 3,000 Simultaneous Player Rendering (thousands in one spot, creating together)  

  • Climbing, Gliding , Flying, Swimming and more (adventure your way)  

  • Pets (collect companions for your travels- much more to come here)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Quad Core Intel or AMD processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 or Radeon R9 Fury X
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit or Higher
  • Processor: Intel i5 7th Gen, AMD Ryzen 5 or Higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2070 or Radeon RX 6600XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
